description: Two sample and hold sections in 3HP, each capturing a voltage when it is triggered and holding it until the next trigger

inputs.text: A rise above 0V captures the voltage at that section's input
The voltage captured by that section when it is triggered; with this jack empty the section captures a random voltage instead, drawn from a normal distribution with a standard deviation of 2.5V

outputs.text: Holds the voltage that section captured at its last trigger

notes: Mono only: a polyphonic cable patched in is read as its first channel alone, and each output carries one channel
